meaning:
1) to store up, save, lay up
1a) (Qal) to store up, make treasurer
1b) (Niphal) treasured

elsewhere.note: ‘Behold, the days come that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store to this day, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will…
I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur…
Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh…
“Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says Yahweh, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”
